build_dictionary: build a word dictionary from a text file mapping words to integer indices
create_corpus: create a Corpus object from train valid and test text files in a data directory
tokenize_text: tokenize a text file into a PyTorch LongTensor of word indices using a dictionary
batchify_data: batchify a 1D data tensor into a 2D tensor with a specified batch size
get_train_val_test_data: get batched train validation and test data tensors split across distributed devices
